Name: De-Jojafied Golden Parrot
Author: Suntooth
Description: The Golden Parrot working for Joja really annoys me, so I made its perch golden instead. I also removed Morris from the cutscene, removing the implication that he got all of the money (thanks ﻿MellyJustMelly for the tip on how to do that!).

Downloads.Description: Removed Morris from the parrot cutscene (thank you MellyJustMelly for the tip!)

Manifest.Name: De-Jojafied Golden Parrot
Manifest.Description: Removes the Joja branding from the Golden Joja Parrot's perch, and Morris from the parrot's cutscene.
